Start date: 1729-02-24  
Add 32 weeks = 224 days, plus 5 days = 229 days.  
1729 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Days in Feb 1729 = 28, so Feb 24 + 5 days → Mar 1, then remaining 224 days.  
From Mar 1:  
Mar (31) → Apr 1 after 31 days, 193 left.  
Apr (30) → May 1 after 30 days, 163 left.  
May (31) → Jun 1 after 31 days, 132 left.  
Jun (30) → Jul 1 after 30 days, 102 left.  
Jul (31) → Aug 1 after 31 days, 71 left.  
Aug (31) → Sep 1 after 31 days, 40 left.  
Sep (30) → Oct 1 after 30 days, 10 left.  
Oct 1 + 10 days = Oct 11, 1729.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1729-10-11
